title: ADMESH: automatic unstructured triangular mesh generator for 2D shallow-water models (Python)

creators.name: Kubatko, Ethan J.
creators.affiliation: Computational Hydrodynamics and Informatics Lab, The Ohio State University

description:
This is a Python and C++ implementation of the ADMESH unstructured triangular mesh generator for two-dimensional shallow-water models (Conroy, Kubatko and West, 2012). It ports the 13 stages of that algorithm, which build a mesh-size field from boundary curvature, channel width, bathymetric gradient and tidal wavelength, then place nodes by distmesh relaxation. triangulate() accepts a domain object, a TOML or JSON polygon, an ADCIRC fort.14 file or a registry domain name; the package reads and writes fort.14 and Gmsh 2.2 files and meshes several domains in parallel with triangulate_batch. A Numba solver replaces the original C MEX file. Install with pip install admesh2D; the import name is admesh. The original research group's MATLAB line continues separately as ADMESH+ v3 (Kang and Kubatko, 2024). This package ports the 2012 library; its optional medial_method="vdt" follows the medial-axis method of Kang and Kubatko (2024).

This release (1.1.0)

Removed

  • Breaking: admesh.quad_prep (smooth_for_quadrangulation) and the unreleased admesh.quad_layers prototype moved to QuADMESH, with no deprecation shim. Use from quadmesh.quad_prep import smooth_for_quadrangulation. quad_prep is not yet on PyPI, so install QuADMESH from its repository until QuADMESH publishes it. admesh.quality.right_iso_quality stays in ADMESH.

Changed

  • Minimum Python is 3.11.
  • triangulate() defaults to boundary="fixed": every input boundary vertex is kept, and the nodes between them are spaced by a 1D relaxation along the boundary that follows the size field. Pass boundary="free" for the 1.0.6 behaviour.
  • The TOML, JSON, fort.14 and registry loaders carry outer and inner boundary rings (Domain.pts, Domain.holes) and compute the signed distance exactly with shapely 2. A full Chesapeake Bay fixed-mode run takes 50 s instead of 228 s.

Added

  • admesh.boundary_relax, Domain.holes, triangulate(channel_refine=...), triangulate(simplify=...) and admesh.size_field.limit_gradient.

Roadmap at 1.1.0

  • Now: 1D–2D constraint extraction (#186).
  • Next: single-mesh parallel speed-up (#216, #218).
  • Later: 3D ADMESH (#220); integration with QuADMESH (quads) and CHILmesh (mesh data structure and smoothing).
